comment.description:
Additional comments regarding the pick-up/delivery reason.

Nullable.

Behavior:

+ Cannot be filled/edited via External API.

+ Can be filled/edited only through the mobile app.

unit.description: The unit of measurement for dimensions. Selected in Merchant settings. Cannot be edited via External API or by the driver through the mobile app.
The unit of measurement for weight. Selected in Merchant settings. Cannot be edited via External API or by the driver through the mobile app.

currency.description:
Currency type used in transactions.

Behavior:

+ Filled in Merchant settings.

+ Cannot be edited via External API or by the driver through the mobile app.

id.description:
A technical field for interacting with items via API.

Behavior:

+ Automatically generated at the time of item creation.

+ Cannot be edited via External API or by the driver through the mobile app.

line_id.description:
A unique identifier for each line item.

Behavior:

+ Automatically generated at the time of line item creation.

+ Cannot be edited via External API or by the driver through the mobile app.

code.description:
A code associated with the item. Nullable.

Behavior:

+ Can be filled/edited via External API.

+ Cannot be edited by the driver through the mobile app.

description.example: iPhone 13 Silver Gray 256 GB. Help with setup.
description.description:
Description of the item. Always enabled.

Behavior:

+ Must be filled via External API.

+ Can be edited via External API.

+ Cannot be edited by the driver through the mobile app.

picked_up.description:
Indicates if the item has been picked up.

`null` - driver did not change this field. `false` - driver could not pick up this item. `true` - driver picked up this item successfully.

Behavior:

+ Cannot be filled/edited via External API.

+ Can only be filled through the mobile app.

delivered.description:
Indicates if the item has been delivered.

`null` - driver did not change this field. `false` - driver could not deliver this item. `true` - driver delivered this item successfully.

Behavior:

+ Cannot be filled/edited via External API.

+ Can only be filled through the mobile app.

original_lld.description: Nullable. If item was not changed by the driver, then will be `null`.

bulk_quantity_picked_up.description:
Nullable. Integer, min value is 0, max value is 32767.

Behavior:

+ Can be filled/edited via External API.

+ Can be edited by the driver through the mobile app.

bulk_quantity_delivered.description:
Nullable. Integer, min value is 0, max value is 32767.

Behavior:

+ Can be filled/edited via External API.

+ Can be edited by the driver through the mobile app.
